age.evidence: Psilocybin was administered via oral gavage (0.1 mg/kg per os, p.o.) every other day for two weeks, from postnatal day (PND) 34 to PND 44. Animals were tested in the NOR test five days after the final administration

sex.evidence: Male WT (Charles River Laboratories, Italy) and Fmr1/Δ exon 8 rats... our experiments were performed exclusively in male rats.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin was administered via oral gavage (0.1 mg/kg per os, p.o.) every other day for two weeks, from postnatal day (PND) 34 to PND 44... Our dose regimen is consistent with a microdosing paradigm.

handling.evidence: no handling protocol described in methods

group_housing.evidence: housed in groups of three under controlled environmental conditions

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 h light/dark cycle (lights on at 07:00 h). Behavioral experiments... were conducted between 9:00 a.m. and 2:30 p.m.

assays.assay_description: Open field arena; 5-min training with two identical objects, 30-min inter-trial interval, then 5-min test with one familiar and one novel object. Discrimination index and total object exploration time measured. Tested with pretreatment of various antagonists (M100907, WAY-100635, ANA-12).

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin was administered via oral gavage (p.o.); the 5HT2AR antagonist volinanserin... administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: no habituation to the apparatus described

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was placed in an open field arena... and allowed to explore

food_restriction.evidence: standard NOR test with no food in the arena during the 5-min test session

water_restriction.evidence: standard NOR test with no water in the arena during the 5-min test session

time_to_assay.evidence: Animals were tested in the NOR test five days after the final administration

sample_size.evidence: WT-WAY/VEH = 6 (smallest group across the four NOR cohorts reported in Figs. 1 and 3)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin microdosing (0.1 mg/kg, p.o.) rescued NOR deficits in Fmr1Δexon8 rats, increasing the discrimination index. The effect was not blocked by 5HT2AR antagonist M100907 (0.25 mg/kg) or 5HT1AR antagonist WAY-100635 (0.3 mg/kg), nor by low-dose ANA-12 (0.5 mg/kg), but was abolished by high-dose TrkB antagonist ANA-12 (1.0 mg/kg). Total object exploration time was unaffected across all conditions.
outcomes.statistics: M100: genotype F(1,66)=12.57, p<0.001; psilocybin F(1,66)=11.95, p<0.001; genotype×psilocybin F(1,66)=20.40, p<0.001. WAY: genotype F(1,59)=11.43, p<0.01; psilocybin F(1,59)=4.95, p<0.05; genotype×psilocybin F(1,59)=23.31, p<0.001. ANA-12 1.0: genotype F(1,60)=71.62, p<0.001; psilocybin F(1,60)=9.696, p<0.01; genotype×psilocybin F(1,60)=14.79, p<0.001; ANA-12×psilocybin F(1,60)=5.156, p<0.05
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin improved performance in the NOR task... the higher dose of ANA-12 (1.0 mg/kg) abolished psilocybin's beneficial effect on object recognition

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on the NOR test as the primary assay. GPT-OSS added OFT and EPM as separate assays, but the paper states these were conducted in a separate cohort and described only in Supplementary Information; the main text provides no scoreable detail. Per the rubric's instruction to base scores only on what is explicitly stated in the paper (main text supplied), and given the lack of any data in the provided markdown, OFT/EPM are excluded from the main consolidated output.
B1 scored 2-3: DI + total object exploration time are explicitly reported (2 measures).
B4 scored Yes: sniffing/touching object exploration is a direct ethological behaviour (rather than only a position-based measure).
D1 scored 'Multiple discrete sessions' because both the training trial and test trial are recorded and exploration times reported for both phases.
D5 scored Yes: NOR was performed 5 days after the last psilocybin dose (>=24 h post-acute).
Schedule classified as 'microdosing' per authors' explicit framing ('Our dose regimen is consistent with a microdosing paradigm').
application_type set to 'multiple' because antagonists (M100907, WAY-100635, ANA-12) were given i.p. in combination with oral psilocybin within the same assay.
